nativeTypography.scope: Account menu, switch labels, league row titles, hero/privacy/invitation copy and all explicit Account body text; no font or prefix exceptions

checks.forcedColorControls: computed Canvas/CanvasText off track/thumb, Highlight/HighlightText on track/thumb and selected theme; real Appearance off/on/off and Dark/Light/System controls

knownBaselineChecks: Original dependency notes are historical. Fresh unchanged next-tokens15 and strict three-import authbridge1 pass; no full CI claim.
limitations: OS share sheet and fake browser push-device edge are local test doubles; real native controllers and push SQL are exercised
Existing browser-owned dirty-reload confirmation is preserved; no new dialog inferred from the storyboard
Existing intentional league-title ellipsis is separately checked for actual clipping and viewport bounds
Shared frame/header/sports-row/dock position remains held; no Community/FEPL access moved
Appearance miniature is a decorative material sample without fictional account progress
